verdict.rationale: Sellers publish product, price, availability and variant data to Stripe via a CSV catalog feed, with inventory and pricing refreshed as often as every 15 minutes. Agent builders can ingest that feed and discover products across protocols, and Link CLI documents product search over UCP. But the agent-side read path is private preview, gated per seller by an OCA agreement, and limited to physical goods in select countries, so coverage is not 'any listed product'. Missing for 10: a documented agent-facing offer schema or read API exposing price, availability and variants; explicit machine-readable checkout links per offer; general availability beyond private preview and OCA-gated sellers; independent hands-on corroboration.
